name: ZCA_AG_SIGNAL_DEFN
description: This table is used to capture the seeded signal definitions for a given object.

columns.name: AG_SIGNAL_DEFN_ID
columns.description: System Generated Identifier and Primary Key

columns.name: SIGNAL_NAME_CODE
columns.description: The name of the signal which can function as the unique PUID. This should be unique across all objects.

columns.name: OBJECT_TYPE_CODE
columns.description: Foreign key reference to ZCA_AG_OBJECTS

columns.name: EVENT_TYPE
columns.description: Signal Definition metadata for the header

columns.name: RELATED_OBJECT_TYPE_CODE
columns.description: The name of the Related Object to be defined in the Signal. This is used for the Team based signals

columns.name: CHANGE_ATTRIBUTES
columns.description: The attributes which will trigger an UPDATE event

columns.name: SIGNAL_DEF_ID
columns.description: Foreign key TO ZCA_SIGNAL_DEFINITIONS table. This will be null when seeded and populated when actual signal is created in the system.

columns.name: PREDEFINED_FLAG
columns.description: Y(Default for OOTB seed data) , N

columns.name: RUN_MODE
columns.description:
ALL , FILTERED.  ALLCUSTOM
ALL:  Indicates  the signal  should run all rules, mainly used for CREATE,DELETE signals, but can be used for any signal.
FILTERED: Indicates  the signal should only run the rules corresponding to this signal in ZCA_AG_SIGNAL_DEFN_RULES. This is used mainly for the Predefined Rules.
ALLCUSTOM: Run all custom rules for this signal.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: REQUEST_ID
columns.description: Enterprise Service Scheduler: indicates the request ID of the job that created or last updated the row.

columns.name: SEED_DATA_SOURCE
columns.description: Source of seed data record. A value of 'BULK_SEED_DATA_SCRIPT' indicates that record was bulk loaded. Otherwise, specifies the name of the seed data file.

columns.name: HYBRID_RULE_FLAG
columns.description: Flag to indicate if this signal should kick off Hybrid Rules processing .Default Value = 'N'

columns.name: ORA_SEED_SET1
columns.description: Oracle internal use only. Indicates the edition-based redefinition (EBR) context of the row for SET1. Context values are Y or N.

columns.name: ORA_SEED_SET2
columns.description: Oracle internal use only. Indicates the edition-based redefinition (EBR) context of the row for SET2. Context values are Y or N.
